definitions.explanation: A smartphone that costs significantly less than flagship models, or a smartphone used with a budget mobile carrier (MVNO) plan.

examples.japanese: {格安|かくやす}スマホ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to a budget smartphone.

examples.japanese: {格安|かくやす}スマホ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: A budget smartphone is good enough.

examples.japanese: {格安|かくやす}スマホにしたら⟦{月々|つきづき}→月々：30032_tsukizuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧になった。
examples.english: When I switched to a budget smartphone plan, my monthly bill was cut in half.

notes:
{格安|かくやす}スマホ can refer to either inexpensive phone hardware or phone service through MVNOs (Mobile Virtual Network Operators) that offer cheaper plans than major carriers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格安|かくやす}スマホ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧ (to switch to a budget smartphone)
- {格安|かくやす}スマホ{会社|がいしゃ} (budget smartphone company/MVNO)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{格安|かくやす}→格安：15125_kakuyasu⟧SIM: budget SIM card
- MVNO: mobile virtual network operator
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦キャリア→キャリア：10821_kyaria⟧: major carrier
